You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How long will the choir be caroling in total? The choir plans to sing "Deck the Halls" twice. The choir plans to sing "Jingle Bells" once. "Deck the Halls" is 150 seconds long. "Jingle Bells" is 240 seconds long. The choir will receive a commemorative certificate after caroling. A volunteer will distribute songbooks before the performance begins. The caroling event will take place outdoors in the town square. The choir will perform the song "Silent Night" in a separate concert three times. A children's choir, not this caroling choir, will sing "O Come, All Ye Faithful" once at a school assembly.
